items.title: Asteroids

items.history_credit: Atari — original arcade game
history_paragraphs: Atari launched Asteroids in arcades in 1979. Its rotating ship, wraparound playfield, and fragmented space rocks became a foundational action-game design.
This BREW archive documents a later phone copy, not the original arcade binary or a verified licensee of this exact port.

items.title: BioShock 3D

items.history_credit: IG Fun — documented mobile adaptation

history_sources.label: Pocket Gamer: BREW 2008 BioShock Mobile report
Pocket Gamer: IG Fun on mobile BioShock development

history_paragraphs: At BREW 2008, IG Fun demonstrated a real-time, fully 3D mobile adaptation of BioShock. Contemporary reporting described a BREW handset rendering the action rather than simply playing a prerecorded animation.
The company also worked on a different 2D BioShock edition for less powerful handsets. Both existed because mobile chips, screen resolutions, and carrier requirements varied so dramatically.
